english.title: Candidate/agent print/publish/promote newspaper advert re election candidate without printer/publisher details
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of an illegal practice in that, being

(A)_[a candidate]_
(B)_[an election agent of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..),]_

at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), you were the

(C)_[promoter of material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure your election at that election and which was published in an advertisement contained in a newspaper or periodical, namely **(..SPECIFY NEWSPAPER OR PERIODICAL..),]_
(D)_[promoter of material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of that candidate at that election and which was published in an advertisement contained in a newspaper or periodical, namely **(..SPECIFY NEWSPAPER OR PERIODICAL..),]_
(E)_[publisher of material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure your election at that election and was in an advertisement contained in a newspaper or periodical, namely **(..SPECIFY NEWSPAPER OR PERIODICAL..),]_
(F)_[publisher of material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of that candidate at that election and was in an advertisement contained in a newspaper or periodical, namely **(..SPECIFY NEWSPAPER OR PERIODICAL..),]_
(G)_[printer of an advertisement in a newspaper or periodical, namely **(..SPECIFY NEWSPAPER OR PERIODICAL..),which contained material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure your election at that election]_
(H)_[printer of an advertisement in a newspaper or periodical, namely **(..SPECIFY NEWSPAPER OR PERIODICAL..),which contained material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of that candidate at that election]_

when

(I)_[your name and address did not appear on its first or last page]_
(J)_[the name and address of the candidate did not appear on its first or last page]_
(K)_[the printer of that newspaper or periodical did not appear on its first or last page]_
(L)_[the name and address of the promoter of the material was not included in the advertisement]_
(M)_[the name and address of the person on behalf of whom the material was being published was not included in the advertisement]_
(N)_[**(..SPECIFY COMBINATION OF ABOVE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 110(2)(a), (6), (9) and (12) and 169 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being an election candidate or agent
published, promoted or printed advert in newspaper or periodical
containing material reasonably regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of a candidate
when printers name and address did not appear on first or last page or
name and address of promoter or person whose behalf material was published was not included

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see section 176

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
